test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who founded the Arya Mahila Samaj?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Pandita Raambai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian social reformer Pandita Ramabai Sarasvati** lived from **23 April 1858 to 5 April 1922**. She was the first woman to be given the titles of **Sarasvati and Pandita as a Sanskrit scholar **after being evaluated by the University of Calcutta faculty.
 
• During the late **19th and early 20th centuries, Pandita Ramabai** was a social worker, scholar, and advocate for women's rights, freedom, and education. She is regarded as one of** India's most significant female reformers **and was the first to advocate for the education and welfare of Indian widows.
 
• **November 30, 1882, saw the founding of the Arya Mahila Samaj**.
 
• Pandita Ramabai started it with the intention of "empowering and educating** each lady to lead a dignified life." **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Stree Mahamandal was established in Allahabad** in 1910 by **Sarala Devi Chaudhurani **(born Sarala Ghosal; 9 September 1872 – 18 August 1945), an **Indian educator and political leader.** In India, this was the country's first women's organisation. The organization's promotion of** female education was one of its main objectives.**
 
• **Sarojini Naidu was an Indian political activist, feminist, and poet** who lived from 13 February 1879 to 2 March 1949. She played a significant role in India's fight for independence from colonial control as a supporter of **civil rights, women's emancipation, and anti-imperialist beliefs.**
 
• **Dhondo Keshav Karve, also known as Maharshi Karve **(18 April 1858–9 November 1962), was a social reformer in India who focused on the **welfare of women. **He supported widow remarriage and got married to a widow himself.
